description: Design data transcribed from S1 for the 2005 Accord motor (#92). Values exactly as printed; 'derived' entries are computed in tools/honda_accord_request.py.

read_at_drawing_scale.note: Scaled from the drawing (30.6 mm = 466 px).

fig_2_4_photo_estimates.note: Rough estimates from the end-plate-removed photo (Fig. 2.4d); low resolution.

text.stator: Segmented 'daisy-chain' stator: a lamination stack and bobbin coil per tooth (Figs. 2.2, 2.3); every tooth wound.
text.rotor: Interior PMs embedded near the rotor surface; two magnets per pole with a lamination rib between them (Fig. 2.4).

not_published: rotor pocket drawing (depth, bridges, rib, end barriers)
locked-rotor current pattern (not restated in S1)
test temperatures for back-EMF and locked-rotor
